package work

type Runner interface {
	Run(n int) int
}

type Worker struct{}

func (Worker) Run(n int) int { return n + 1 }

func DirectTarget(n int) int { return n * 2 }

func Step(n int) int { return n + 10 }

func InvokeFn(fn func(int) int, n int) int {
	return fn(n)
}

func CallStatic() int {
	return DirectTarget(3)
}

func CallConcrete() int {
	var w Worker
	return w.Run(4)
}

func CallInterface(r Runner) int {
	return r.Run(5)
}

func CallStepDirect() int {
	return Step(6)
}

func CallStepViaValue() int {
	return InvokeFn(Step, 7)
}
